description: Build the Godot game and register the version in the workspace: smoke test (GF_SMOKE=1, script errors fail the build), headless export for the preset (macos | windows | linux | web; presets written into export_presets.cfg when missing), zip, upload as a Library "build" (kind kit, meta.tool=build: game, version, preset, commit, engine, size, smoke) and return the download URL. Needs Godot installed locally (GODOT_BIN or /Applications/Godot.app) and the export templates for the platform. 0 credits.

smoke.description: run the GF_SMOKE=1 launch before exporting

upload.description: push the zip to the workspace

version.description: e.g. 0.3.0 — default: project.godot config/version, else git describe, else date

name: gripforge_build
